query: We just launched a new payments API in production and we're flying blind. What should we instrument first?
expected_behavior: Starts with the Four Golden Signals or RED (Rate, Errors, Duration) as the default first instrumentation for a request-driven service
Splits latency into success vs error latency and uses a histogram for percentiles, not an average
Recommends structured logs carrying trace_id/span_id and OpenTelemetry tracing so a slow or failed request can be localized in the call graph
Warns against putting unbounded-cardinality labels (raw user_id, full URL) on metrics and puts that detail on traces/logs instead
Frames the goal as explaining the running system, distinct from pre-release testing (qa) or codebase health scoring (system-health)
